title: A/B tests
subtitle: One link splits visitors across 2–3 landing pages so you know which page brings more orders
empty_hint: Make 2 or 3 versions of your landing page in the editor, publish them, then compare them here.
name: Test name
confirm_winner: All visitors will go to this page and the test will stop. Continue?
confirm_delete: Delete this test? Its linked domain goes back to the winning (or first) page.
low_data: Not much data yet — wait for at least 100 views per page before deciding.
domain_hint: An mdstore.top subdomain works immediately, or your own domain (needs DNS setup as on the Domains page). Counts toward your plan's domain limit.
domain_existing_hint: Your ad link stays the same and the current page becomes one of the variants — add it in the list above.
no_free_domains: No landing-page domains in this store
choose_product: Pick the product whose pages you're testing
need_two_pages: This product has only {{count}} published page(s) — you need at least 2. Duplicate its page in the editor, change it, then publish it.
